ok I need to vent again and this one actually matters so please read it.

remember the switchblade moth off my september flash sheet? the one I said was my favorite thing I drew all year? I posted that sheet aug 30, drew the whole thing at my kitchen table over like 3 weekends, and the moth went in the first hour of flash day on the 13th.

tonight a friend sends me a listing from a shop called StickerBurrow Co. "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal." $6.50, or 3 for $15. and its my moth. not kinda my moth, not "giving moth vibes," MY moth. same little crack in the blade. same wing pattern. they didnt even flip it lol. its not "inspired by," its a straight scan of my linework printed on vinyl.

so I messaged them. nice about it. told them its my design from my flash sheet, I have the original drawing and the post from august, please take it down. heres what I got back, basically word for word:

"Hey! Love your work. Our artists create original designs inspired by trending styles. Moths are a very common tattoo motif and we can't remove listings based on similarity alone. If you have a registered copyright feel free to send it through our support form. Have a great day!"

love your work!!! have a great day!!! babe you are SELLING my work. yes moths are common. I've seen a thousand moths. I have never seen another moth holding a switchblade with that exact crack in the exact spot, because I put it there.

and the registered copyright thing. you own the copyright on something the second you draw it. registration is what you need if you want to take somebody to court, and these sticker places know damn well a small shop isnt dropping thousands on a lawyer over a $6.50 decal. thats the whole business model. take art from people who cant afford to fight back and hide behind a support form.

ok but heres the part that actually made me sick.

if you dont know how flash works: when you buy a piece of flash, thats it. ONE time, ONE person. I dont tattoo it again, I dont sell prints of it, it doesnt end up on a t-shirt. thats the deal, and thats a big part of what you're paying for. you're getting something nobody else has.

so the person who got this moth found out tonight because somebody showed them a sticker of their own tattoo. and their first thought was that I was the one selling it. which, honestly, I get. if I was them I'd wonder too.

so to you, if you're reading this: it was NOT me. I've never printed it, sold it, licensed it, nothing. I found out tonight same as you and I'm furious about it on your behalf. you paid for one of one and you're gonna have one of one as far as I can do anything about it. I'll message you properly too, but I wanted this to be public so nobody else wonders either.

so here's what I'm asking:

1. go report the listing. StickerBurrow Co, "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal." report it as stolen artwork / IP infringement, whatever option the site gives you. the more reports the harder it is for them to ignore.
2. dont buy from them. if theyre doing this to me theyre doing it to other artists too. I promise.
3. if you see my stuff, or anybody's flash, turning up on random sticker and print shops, tell the artist. most of us never find out.

and if you want a moth sticker that bad I'll literally draw you a different moth for free lol. just not that one. that one belongs to somebody.

I'm gonna go eat something and stop staring at my phone. thanks for reading this far. love yall
